description: [Data utilities] Check whether weather or US airport delays will affect a flight, pickup or shipment. Use when planning around a specific airport in the next hours. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/airport-weather

airport.description: ICAO (EKCH, KJFK) or IATA (CPH, JFK) airport code

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: airport_weather
title: Airport Weather & Delays (METAR, TAF, FAA) ($0.003)
